data.name: Mamtaj
data.gender_notes: Mamtaj is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mamtaj is a name that embodies the essence of love, affection, and tenderness. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mamta', which means 'motherly love'. This name is often used to describe a woman who is nurturing, caring, and compassionate. The name Mamtaj carries the meaning “Love, Affection, Tenderness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Mamtaj usually hope their child will grow to embody love, affection, tenderness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mamtaj is a name that represents the divine feminine energy of love and compassion. It is believed to bring blessings of maternal love, nurturing, and protection.
data.etymology: Mamtaj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Love, Affection, Tenderness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mamtaj total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
